payload.description: A booming, larger-than-life arcade fighting game announcer in his forties. Deep, powerful American baritone with a little grit, shouting with adrenaline-pumping hype into a stadium microphone. Every word punched with crisp hard consonants and clean sharp S sounds, dramatic stretched vowels on the big calls. Huge arena energy, clean close studio recording, no music, no reverb.
